instructions: This repository is a public, append-only history of signed Merkle anchors written by Interlok's anchor job. Its value is that nobody can quietly rewrite it.

rules.rule: Existing files under anchors/ must never be modified, renamed or deleted. A pull request may only add new anchor files. Flag any change to an existing anchor file as high severity.

A new anchor file is anchors/<org uuid>/<12-digit to_seq>.json with org_id matching its folder, from_seq <= to_seq, count = to_seq - from_seq + 1, from_seq continuing after the previous file's to_seq for that org, 64-hex merkle_root, head_hash and anchor_hash, an ISO-8601 ts, a base64url signature and a signer_kid.
Nothing in this repository is secret. Flag any private key material, token, credential or ledger entry contents.
